source.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

accepted.question_text: Do there exist any classical 10-dimensional string backgrounds with a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, D-brane sources, and orientifold sources in which all sources are parallel, or is every such classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources impossible?

evidence.quote:
Classical 10d string backgrounds with a 4d de Sitter space-time, D-brane and orientifold sources, are commonly believed to satisfy the following:
1. There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.
Conjecture 1 There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.

accepted.question_text: For classical 10-dimensional string backgrounds with a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, D-brane sources, and orientifold sources, must every classical de Sitter solution that contains intersecting sources be perturbatively unstable, equivalently having at least one tachyonic 4-dimensional scalar mode?

evidence.quote:
Classical 10d string backgrounds with a 4d de Sitter space-time, D-brane and orientifold sources, are commonly believed to satisfy the following:
2. Classical de Sitter solutions with intersecting sources are unstable.
Conjecture 2 Classical de Sitter solutions with intersecting sources are unstable.

accepted.question_text: Can a classical de Sitter solution in a classical 10-dimensional string background with a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, D-brane sources, and orientifold sources simultaneously have all four of the following properties: large internal volume, small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds, and quantized fluxes; or is such a combination impossible?

evidence.quote:
Classical 10d string backgrounds with a 4d de Sitter space-time, D-brane and orientifold sources, are commonly believed to satisfy the following:
3. Classical de Sitter solutions cannot have at the same time a large internal volume, a small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds and quantized
fluxes.
Conjecture 3 Classical de Sitter solutions cannot have at the same time a large internal volume, a small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds and quantized fluxes.
